name: Legend Holdings Corporation
summary: Legend Holdings Corporation, along with its subsidiaries, operates in the industrial operations and industrial incubations and investments sectors in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company provides intelligent devices and infrastructure, creates intelligent solutions, services, and software; research, develops, produces, and sells advanced material products; engages in agriculture and food-related businesses; and offers integrated banking services, including corporate and institutional banking, retail banking, private banking, and capital markets.
